title: Your 2027, Month by Month

intake.question: What do you want 2027 to be about?

plan.title: April and May: things heat up
Your elements in a fire year
December and January: closing the year

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. You'll want to use the whole year at full speed. You'll be exhausted by September.

Bom: You have real energy for this one.

Yeon: So pace it. Two big pushes, two real rests, the rest ordinary.

Pick your two push months now. Put them in your calendar before January does it for you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Two sprints, two rests. Not twelve sprints and a collapse.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. A fire year can feel like a lot: busy, loud, everyone wanting something.

Yeon: Which means saying no is your 2027 skill. Practise it in January.

Bom: The year can lift you if you pick a few things and let the rest pass by.

Choose three things for the year. Write them down. Anything not on the list gets a polite "not this year".

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Three things for 2027. Everything else can wait.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart, so you'll keep adding goals as the year goes on. By June your plan will have a plan.

Bom: Fewer goals, chosen carefully, work better for you.

Keep a "not this year" list. Every shiny new idea goes there. You can open it in 2028.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: New idea in July? "Not this year" list. Open it in 2028.

weak.text:
Bom: Soft chart, so your plan needs kindness built in. Small goals, real rest, supportive people.

Yeon: Pick one thing you'll protect however busy it gets. A morning. A friend. A walk.

That's the plan's backbone. Everything else bends around it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Name your one non-negotiable for 2027. Guard it.

peer_strong.text:
Your chart is packed with {dm_el}, your own element. You steer your own ship and you do not enjoy being steered.

Yeon: Somebody suggests a better route and you take a worse one out of principle.

Bom: In 2027, months that bring more of your own element can feel like too much of a good thing. Months that bring your outlet or your goals feel productive.

In the crowded, social months, collaborate instead of compete. You'll get further, and you'll have company.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Heavy on your own element. In the crowded months, team up instead of winning.

output_strong.text:
Your chart is heavy on {heavy_el}, the element your {dm_el} produces. Expression. You want to make, say and share things constantly.

Bom: In a month that backs you, that's magic.

Yeon: In a month that's already pulling you outward, it's how you end up with nine half-finished projects and a sore throat.

Keep an honest eye on how you feel, and save the big creative pushes for the months that refill you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Heavy {heavy_el}: big creative pushes go where you get refilled.

wealth_strong.text:
Your chart is heavy on {heavy_el}, the element your {dm_el} controls: goals, results, ticking things off.

Yeon: You'll treat every month like a deadline. Even August. Especially August.

Bom: Let some months be about people and rest. Results tend to come easier after them, not instead of them.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Goal mode all year? Hand two months to your friends instead.

power_strong.text:
Your chart is heavy on {heavy_el}, the element that shapes your {dm_el}: duty, standards, doing it properly.

Bom: You take on responsibilities and you keep them. People rely on that.

Yeon: Which is how you end up running three group projects you never signed up for.

Watch the months that pile extra pressure on top. Those are the months to say no to anything new.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Heavy {heavy_el}: dutiful. In pressure months, decline the extra duty.

resource_strong.text:
Your chart is heavy on {heavy_el}, the element that feeds your {dm_el}: learning, thinking, going inward.

Yeon: You've read four books about the thing instead of doing the thing.

Bom: Reflection is lovely. It's most useful when it leads somewhere. Make sure some months in 2027 are for action.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Heavy {heavy_el}: very reflective. Book a few months for actually doing.

output_weak.text:
Your chart leans on {heavy_el}, the element your {dm_el} produces: giving, expressing, showing up for everyone.

Bom: On a soft chart, that drains faster than you'd think.

Yeon: Guard yourself in the months that pull you outward even more. Fewer projects. Actually finished.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Fewer projects, finished. Go easy in the outward months.

wealth_weak.text:
Your chart leans on {heavy_el}, the element your {dm_el} controls. Lots to manage, not much of you to manage it with.

Yeon: You'll say yes to carrying things you can't carry. Then carry them anyway, grumpily.

Bom: Use the supportive months to ask for help and share the load. That's not weakness. That's logistics.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Lots to carry. In the supportive months, hand some of it over.

power_weak.text:
Your chart leans on {heavy_el}, the element that presses on your {dm_el}.

Bom: Pressure months tend to feel heavier for you than for most people. That's not you being dramatic. That's the chart.

Yeon: So lower the bar in those months, on purpose, and protect whatever steadies you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Pressure months: lower the bar, protect what steadies you.

rooted_on_paper.text:
Yeon: In a year plan, that gap means some months you'll feel unstoppable and some months oddly wobbly.

Bom: Both are normal for your chart. Notice which months bring support and lean into them.

Treat the other months as months for care, not for proving anything.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Confident some months, shaky in others. Normal for your chart. Not a flaw.

output_strong.text:
{miss_el} isn't in the pillars we can see, and for your {dm_el} it's the output element: expression.

Bom: So the months that bring {miss_el} tend to feel unusually chatty and creative for you.

Yeon: Use them to share the work you've been sitting on. You know the one.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: {miss_el} months make you talkative. Share something in them.

wealth_strong.text:
{miss_el} is absent from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the wealth element: going after things.

Yeon: Months that bring {miss_el} nudge you toward goals and opportunities.

Bom: Say yes to the right ones. Not every shiny one.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: {miss_el} months bring chances. Choose, don't collect.

power_strong.text:
{miss_el} is the gap in your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the power element: structure.

Bom: Months with {miss_el} may bring responsibility or rules you didn't order.

Yeon: Use them to build a good habit while the structure's there for free.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: {miss_el} months bring structure. Build a habit while it's there.

resource_strong.text:
{miss_el} doesn't appear in your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the resource element: support and learning.

Bom: Months that bring {miss_el} are good for study, mentors and real rest.

Yeon: Use them. Don't fill them with errands.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: {miss_el} months: study and rest. Protect them from errands.

output_weak.text:
{miss_el} is missing from the pillars we can see, and for your {dm_el} it's the output element.

Bom: Months with {miss_el} will invite you to express yourself.

Yeon: Do it in small, sustainable doses. A post, not a podcast series.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When {miss_el} months come, express yourself in small doses.

wealth_weak.text:
{miss_el} isn't in your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the wealth element.

Yeon: Months with {miss_el} bring opportunities. Take one. Not five. One.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: {miss_el} months: one opportunity. Not five.

power_weak.text:
{miss_el} is absent from the pillars we can see, and for your {dm_el} it's the power element.

Bom: Months that bring {miss_el} may feel demanding. Keep your diary lighter then, before anyone else fills it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Keep the diary light when {miss_el} months arrive.

resource_weak.text:
{miss_el} is the gap in your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the resource element: support.

Bom: That makes months with {miss_el} your refills.

Yeon: Plan rest and your nicest people into them. In ink.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: {miss_el} months are refills. Book the rest in ink.

none_strong.text:
Every element turns up somewhere in your pillars, so each month meets something familiar in you.

Bom: Overall the year should feel fairly balanced.

Yeon: Balanced can quietly turn into drifting. Pick your priorities clearly so it doesn't.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: All five elements present. Pick priorities so balance doesn't become drift.

none_weak.text:
You've got all five elements somewhere in your pillars, so you adapt to each month's mood fairly easily.

Yeon: Handy. Also how you spend a whole year adapting to everyone else.

Bom: Keep a few fixed anchors in 2027 that nobody gets to move.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Adaptable all year. Keep a few anchors nobody else gets to move.

resource.title: Your steadying element for 2027: {helper_el}
resource.text:
Every chart has an element that brings it back to centre. For your soft {dm_el} chart, it's {helper_el}, the element that feeds your Day Master.

Bom: Months that bring {helper_el} tend to be your easier ones.

Yeon: In the other months, bring it in yourself: people, places and routines that refill you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your steadying element in 2027: {helper_el}. Bring it in on purpose.

peer.title: Your steadying element for 2027: {helper_el}, your own element
peer.text:
Every chart has an element that brings it back to centre. Yours already has plenty of nourishment on paper, so what steadies you is your own element, {helper_el}.

Bom: In real life that's friends, peers, people on your wavelength.

Yeon: Put them in the calendar across the whole year, not only when it's on fire.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your steadying element: {helper_el}. Your people, booked all year.

output.title: Where your 2027 force should go: {helper_el}
output.text:
Every chart has an element that brings it back to centre. A strong {dm_el} chart needs an outlet, and yours is {helper_el}, the element your Day Master produces.

Bom: Put the year's force into creating and sharing.

Yeon: Months that bring {helper_el} are good for putting things out into the world. Launch then.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your 2027 outlet is {helper_el}. Launch things in its months.

wealth.title: The element that keeps your 2027 grounded: {helper_el}
wealth.text:
Every chart has an element that brings it back to centre. Yours is strong and already very expressive, so what balances you is {helper_el}, the element your Day Master shapes.

Yeon: Translation: fewer ideas, more finished things.

Bom: Aim at concrete goals in 2027. Months that bring {helper_el} are good for completing what you started.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: {helper_el} balances you in 2027. Finish things in its months.

wood.text: Wood habits for 2027: morning walks, learning something new, plants on the windowsill, a fresh plan every season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Wood for 2027: walks, plants, a plan each season.

fire.text: Fire habits for 2027: daylight, warm get-togethers, celebrating the small wins, dancing in the kitchen.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Fire for 2027: daylight and small celebrations.

earth.text: Earth habits for 2027: steady routines, home cooking, a tidy home base, going to bed at roughly the same time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Earth for 2027: routine, home cooking, a steady bedtime.

metal.text: Metal habits for 2027: a clear-out every season, clear priorities, finishing tasks, and saying no without a paragraph.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Metal for 2027: clear out each season. "No" with no paragraph.

water.text: Water habits for 2027: quiet evenings, journaling, swims or long baths, thinking time with nothing playing.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Water for 2027: quiet evenings and a journal.

rat.text: Rat and Goat are what saju calls a harm pair: small crossed wires with the people closest to you. Nothing dramatic. Over-explain this year. "I meant this" saves a week of tension.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rat meets Goat: crossed wires. Say what you mean twice.

ox.text: Ox and Goat are opposites, a clash. Expect movement at home: a move, a change, a shift in someone close. Keep one routine steady and the rest can wobble.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Clash year at home. One steady routine keeps you grounded.

tiger.text: Tiger and Goat sit neutral. The year won't shake your inner circle on its own. What you build there is up to you, which is honestly the best deal.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Neutral year at home. Whatever happens, you did it.

rabbit.text: Rabbit and Goat join the Wood trio. A warm link for your personal life: easier connection, friends who feel like family, people on your side.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rabbit and Goat: warm year for your people.

dragon.text: Dragon and Goat sit side by side, two Earth branches. Steady ground at home. Great year for practical home projects. The shelf finally goes up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Steady home year. Build the shelf. Finally.

snake.text: Snake and Goat sit neutral and both run warm. A lively personal life: dinners, plans, plenty of people. Book one quiet weekend a month.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Warm, busy year. Book quiet weekends on purpose.

horse.text: Horse and Goat form a six-harmony pair, one of the sweetest links a year can make with your inner circle. Closeness, ease, support from the people near you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Horse and Goat: one of the sweetest links there is.

goat.text: Goat meets Goat. The year mirrors you, strengths and habits alike. You'll see your own patterns very clearly. Keep the good ones. Name the others.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Mirror year. You'll meet yourself. Be nice to them.

monkey.text: Monkey and Goat sit neutral, and the year's Earth quietly feeds your branch's Metal. Personal plans get gentle support without much drama.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Quiet support at home. Use it for your own plans.

rooster.text: Rooster and Goat sit neutral, with Earth feeding your branch's Metal. A calm year at home. Good time to fix things you've been putting off.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Calm home year. Fix the thing you've been ignoring.

dog.text: Dog and Goat are part of the classic Earth punishment group. Some friction with close people over who does what. Clear agreements save the year.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Friction year at home. Write down who does the dishes.

pig.text: Pig and Goat join the Wood trio. Generous friends, easy cooperation, a warm personal life. Say yes to the people who keep showing up.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Pig and Goat: generous year. Lean on your people.

day_branch_heading: The Goat year meets your inner circle: the {day_animal} ({day_branch})

love.text:
You said love and people. Then the months where your chart feels social or harmonious are your best stage: plan the important conversations and get-togethers there.

Yeon: In the quieter months, stop scouting for new people and deepen the ones you have.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Big people moments go in your harmonious months.

work.text:
You said work and building something. The title and steady-harvest months are for commitments and results, the feast and loudmouth months for creative pushes, the safety-net months for learning.

Yeon: Building is a rhythm. Not a twelve-month sprint followed by a nap in a cupboard.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Commit in title months, create in feast months, learn in safety-net months.

self.text:
You said this year is about you: routines, calm, growing. The safety-net and twin months are your best windows for new routines.

Bom: Start small in February. Check in at the July peak. Review in December. That's the whole method.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Small habits from Ipchun. A July check-in. A December review.

fresh.text:
You said a fresh start. Saju agrees new years begin at Ipchun, so early February is your symbolic restart.

Yeon: Use October and November, the clear-out months, to let go of what's done. Then February to begin. Not before. Clean slate, actually clean.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Ipchun is your restart button. Clear out in autumn, begin in February.

unsaid.text:
You didn't pick a focus, so here's a gentle default: one thing for the first half of the year, one for the second.

Bom: Let the months set the pace. You can always change your mind in July.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: One focus per half-year. The months set the pace.

great.text:
2026 felt great. Bring its best habits with you.

Yeon: Just don't grade 2027 against it month by month. Different years have different jobs. This one isn't a sequel.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Great 2026? Keep the habits. Skip the comparison.

heavy.text:
2026 felt heavy. The Fire Goat can be gentler if you let it: use the supportive months to rest and rebuild before you push.

Bom: You don't owe anyone a comeback by spring. Not even yourself.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Heavy 2026? There's no comeback deadline. Rebuild first.

messy.text:
2026 was messy. A bit of everything, all at once.

Yeon: 2027 rewards simplifying. Fewer commitments, clearer priorities.

Bom: The Metal months of late summer are ideal for sorting what stays.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Messy 2026? Simplify. Late summer is for sorting what stays.

quiet.text:
2026 was quiet. A fire year tends to bring more visibility for most charts.

Bom: Pick one thing to be braver about, and try it in one of your smoother months.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Quiet 2026? Choose one thing to be bold about.

unsaid.text:
You didn't say how 2026 felt. Take a minute and name it, even just to yourself.

Yeon: Knowing where you're starting makes the month-by-month part actually useful.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Name how 2026 felt. Even if only you hear it.

yang.heading: How you move through a year: in bursts
yang.text:
Your Day Master is yang, the outward half of saju's pair. You tend to move in big, visible bursts.

Yeon: Three weeks of total domination, then a week horizontal on the sofa.

Bom: Plan the bursts for the supportive months, and give each one a quieter stretch afterwards.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Yang rhythm: burst, then rest. Schedule both.

yin.heading: How you move through a year: quietly, steadily
yin.text:
Your Day Master is yin, the inward half of saju's pair. Your progress tends to be steady and quiet.

Bom: Don't measure yourself against louder people this year.

Yeon: They post about day one. You show up on day two hundred with the thing finished.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Yin rhythm: quiet, steady, done by December.

wood.heading: The one habit that carries your whole year
wood.text:
Your balancing element is Wood, so your one habit for 2027 is growth: learn one small thing each month. A recipe. A chord. A word in another language.

Yeon: Twelve months, twelve new things. Tiny counts.

Bom: And when Ipchun 2028 comes round, look back at the list. That's who you grew into this year, one month at a time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Wood habit: one new thing a month. Twelve by next Ipchun.

fire.heading: The one habit that carries your whole year
fire.text:
Your balancing element is Fire, so your one habit for 2027 is warmth: one gathering or celebration a month. Small is fine. Cake on a Tuesday counts.

Yeon: Twelve excuses to see your people. You're welcome.

Bom: By next Ipchun you'll have a year full of evenings you're glad happened. That's a good year, whatever else it held.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Fire habit: a small celebration, every single month.

earth.heading: The one habit that carries your whole year
earth.text:
Your balancing element is Earth, so your one habit for 2027 is routine: one fixed weekly anchor. A Sunday reset. A regular meal with someone.

Yeon: Boring on purpose. Boring holds the whole thing up.

Bom: Whatever the months bring, that one anchor will still be there every week. So will you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Earth habit: one weekly anchor. Never skipped.

metal.heading: The one habit that carries your whole year
metal.text:
Your balancing element is Metal, so your one habit for 2027 is clearing: once a month, remove one thing you don't need. An object, a commitment, a habit.

Yeon: Twelve things gone. You won't miss a single one.

Bom: And all that space by next Ipchun? That's room for whatever 2028 brings you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Metal habit: one thing out, every month.

water.heading: The one habit that carries your whole year
water.text:
Your balancing element is Water, so your one habit for 2027 is reflection: ten minutes of journaling at the start of each saju month.

Yeon: Ten minutes. Not a memoir.

Bom: Twelve short entries, and by next Ipchun you'll be able to read your own year back. Most people never get to.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Water habit: ten quiet minutes with a notebook, once a month.

gap-wood.text:
At work, you're the one who finally says the meeting is pointless. With friends, you're funnier and sharper than usual. In love, you want to be admired for what you make.

Yeon: Test every idea with one question: can you show something real in six weeks? If yes, chase it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Six weeks to something real. That's your 2027 filter.

gap-wood.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

eul-wood.text:
You host more. You make more. You finally sign up for the class. Small side opportunities show up through people you already know.

Yeon: Say yes to the fun ones. Say no to the "can you just" ones.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Yes to joy. No to "can you just".

eul-wood.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

byeong-fire.text:
Someone with your energy turns up: a rival, a collaborator, a friend who wants the same spotlight. Your ideas get bolder and your filter gets thinner.

Yeon: Share the stage once. It'll make you look bigger, not smaller.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Two suns in one sky this year. Share the stage.

byeong-fire.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

jeong-fire.text:
Your people multiply: friends of friends, a new team, a crowd that feels like yours. You also want to make something just because you enjoy it.

Bom: Let one creative thing be purely for fun. No audience required.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Make one thing just because you love it.

jeong-fire.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

mu-earth.text:
People who want to teach you, back you or open a door turn up. At the same time, someone close competes for the same thing you want.

Yeon: Take the help. Ignore the scoreboard.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Accept the help this year. You've earned it.

mu-earth.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

gi-earth.text:
You learn something unexpected: a course, a weird hobby, a teacher who appears out of nowhere. Your friend circle tightens and gets louder.

Yeon: Guard your energy. Not everyone at your table should be at your table.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: New year, smaller table, better people.

gi-earth.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

gyeong-metal.text:
Responsibility knocks: a promotion, a title, a role where people look to you. Good support arrives at the same time, if you let it.

Bom: Lead without carrying it alone. That's the 2027 upgrade.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Step up, and let people help you up.

gyeong-metal.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

sin-metal.text:
The pressure's real: deadlines, expectations, one person who tests you. So is the backup. You learn faster this year than you have in ages.

Yeon: Don't polish everything. Polish the thing that counts.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pressure year. Choose which jewel to polish.

sin-metal.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

im-water.text:
Something pulls you in and binds you: a person, a partnership, a project worth committing to. Structure shows up too, and you might actually like it.

Bom: Commitment can feel like freedom when it's the right thing.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Something worth committing to is coming. Notice it.

im-water.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

gye-water.text:
New people, new invitations, a fuller calendar than you're used to. Plus a challenge that asks you to be braver than you'd choose to be.

Yeon: RSVP yes. You can always slip out after an hour.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Show up. One hour still counts.

gye-water.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

wood.heading: What's hiding inside the Goat: a little Wood, 乙
wood.text:
The Goat carries three hidden stems: 己 Earth as the main one, some 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood, spring's leftover tucked inside summer.

Bom: For a Wood Day Master, that sliver is your own element. Like spotting a friend in a crowd.

Peers, siblings, teammates who quietly back you through a year that asks you to give a lot. Work out who they are by spring.

Yeon: You'll want them close by June. June does not mess around.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your own Wood is hiding in the Goat. Spot your allies by spring.

fire.heading: What's hiding inside the Goat: a little Wood, 乙
fire.text:
Inside the Goat sit three hidden stems: 己 Earth leading, some 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood.

Bom: For a Fire Day Master, that hidden Wood is fuel. Your resource element.

It tends to arrive as small, quiet help: the right book at the right time, an older friend's advice, a teacher who sees something in you.

Yeon: Nobody announces it. Keep a list of who helped, and thank them in December. Before that, though, June arrives at full volume.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Hidden Wood feeds your Fire. Small help, delivered quietly. Write it down.

earth.heading: What's hiding inside the Goat: a little Wood, 乙
earth.text:
The Goat holds three hidden stems: 己 Earth as the main one, some 丁 Fire, and a thin sliver of 乙 Wood.

Bom: For an Earth Day Master, that hidden Wood is your power element. Gentle discipline.

The deadline you set yourself. The standard someone you admire holds you to. Mild pressure, the kind that roots a field instead of cracking it.

Yeon: Take on one structured commitment this year and see what grows. Then brace for June, which brings a lot more than mild.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: The hidden Wood is gentle pressure. Say yes to one structured commitment.

metal.heading: What's hiding inside the Goat: a little Wood, 乙
metal.text:
Three hidden stems live in the Goat: 己 Earth in charge, some 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood.

Bom: For a Metal Day Master, that hidden Wood is your wealth element: the things you shape and look after.

Small, practical wins. A skill that pays off later. A tidy system at home. A project actually seen through.

Yeon: Modest, steady results. That's what this Goat rewards. Flashy ones can wait. June will be flashy enough for everyone.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Hidden Wood for Metal: small practical wins, steadily.

water.heading: What's hiding inside the Goat: a little Wood, 乙
water.text:
The Goat hides three stems: 己 Earth as the main one, some 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood.

Bom: For a Water Day Master, that hidden Wood is your output element. Expression, creativity.

In a year where the visible elements press on you, this is your release valve: writing, music, teaching, a hobby that lets something flow out.

Yeon: Ten creative minutes a day, all year. Especially in June, when the heat peaks.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: The hidden Wood is your pressure valve. Ten creative minutes, daily.

spring.heading: You, born in spring, versus the hottest weeks of the year
spring.text:
Spring-born means you carry Wood's momentum, and Wood feeds Fire. June and July tend to feel fast and exciting for you.

Yeon: Right up until you realise you haven't sat down since the solstice.

Bom: Spring-born people often notice tiredness late, after it's already spent. So plan a lighter week straight after midsummer, before you feel you need it.

Yeon: August is coming, and it wants receipts.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring-born: rest after midsummer, before you think you need to.

summer.heading: You, born in summer, versus the hottest weeks of the year
summer.text:
Summer-born: your chart already has plenty of heat, and the 丙午 and 丁未 months double it.

Bom: Expect a peak that's bright and a bit much. Lots of plans, lots of people.

Yeon: Short fuses on hot days. Yours included. Especially yours.

Keep cool on purpose: early mornings, water nearby, fewer evening plans. You don't need more fire in midsummer. You need shade. And in August the heat starts turning into something you can keep.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer-born: midsummer wants shade from you, not more fire.

autumn.heading: You, born in autumn, versus the hottest weeks of the year
autumn.text:
Autumn-born means your chart leans toward Metal's clarity, and Fire melts Metal.

Yeon: So midsummer may feel like pressure. More demands. Louder people. Less room to think.

Bom: It's also when you get shaped into something better. Take the challenges one at a time.

Keep a short weekly review so the heat refines you instead of rattling you. Then August hands you the first cool breath, and you'll know what to do with it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn-born: a weekly review turns the heat into polish.

winter.heading: You, born in winter, versus the hottest weeks of the year
winter.text:
Winter-born: your chart carries cold Water, and a fire peak is warmth it rarely gets.

Bom: Plenty of winter-born people feel unusually good in mid-2027. More social, more confident, happier to be seen.

Yeon: Use it. Make the call. Plan the trip. Launch the thing.

Water and fire will still argue now and then, so keep quiet nights in between. And notice what you start in July. August decides what it becomes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter-born: the fire peak warms you. Use it to be seen.

earth.heading: You, born in the Earth weeks, versus the hottest weeks of the year
earth.text:
Born in the Earth weeks between seasons, your chart has extra ground, and Fire makes Earth.

Bom: Midsummer feeds you. More stability, more confidence, a sense of things stacking up in your favour.

Yeon: Watch the stacking. Too much Earth feels heavy and stuck. Like a sofa you can't get off.

Move your body, clear clutter, and drop one commitment for every two new ones. August is harvest, and you'll want your hands free.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Earth-weeks born: for every two new commitments, drop one.

strong.heading: Pacing 2027 when your chart is strong
strong.text:
A strong chart can take a lot of this year's heat and still want more. That's your edge, and your trap.

Bom: Pace it in three acts. February to May: start things. June to September: push the two that work, drop the rest. October to January: finish, review, rest.

Yeon: The classic strong-chart mistake is starting a new project in October because you still feel great.

Let autumn close loops. And October is about to show you exactly which ones.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Three acts: start, push two, finish. No new projects in October.

weak.heading: Pacing 2027 when your chart is soft
weak.text:
A soft chart in a Fire Goat year paces like a long walk, not a sprint.

Bom: One main goal for 2027. Two small ones. That's it.

Yeon: Push in the supportive months. In the heavier ones, maintain: keep the habit, keep the people, launch nothing.

Rest isn't falling behind. For you, it's how the good months happen at all. Whenever a new saju month begins, check in with yourself and adjust honestly. The next one up is October, and it comes with scissors.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: One main goal, two small ones. Resting is part of the plan.

wood.heading: Sneak preview: 2028, the Earth Monkey
wood.text:
This reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins: the Earth Monkey.

Bom: If you're a Wood Day Master, 戊 Earth is wealth, the ground you work. The Monkey's 庚 Metal is power, the structure that trims a tree into shape.

Yeon: So 2028 is likely to feel more practical and more demanding. Less talk. More results. Clearer expectations.

Use December and January to decide which of this year's ideas get real resources next year. Two, not ten. Which two? That's the last page.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: 2028 is the Earth Monkey. Two ideas get real resources. Not ten.

fire.heading: Sneak preview: 2028, the Earth Monkey
fire.text:
The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins: the Earth Monkey.

Bom: If you're a Fire Day Master, 戊 Earth is output, what your warmth produces. The Monkey's 庚 Metal is wealth, what you shape and manage.

Yeon: After a year of company and heat, 2028 asks you to turn it into something you can hold.

Finish one creative project in the last weeks of 2027, so you walk into the Monkey year with proof, not only plans. Your plan for getting there is on the last page.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: One creative thing, finished, before Ipchun 2028.

earth.heading: Sneak preview: 2028, the Earth Monkey
earth.text:
The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins: the Earth Monkey.

Bom: If you're an Earth Day Master, 戊 is your own element, and the Monkey's 庚 Metal is output.

Yeon: Standing on your own ground and saying what you think. More independence. More ideas out loud.

The Fire Goat fed you. The Monkey asks what you'll make of it. Spend January writing down what 2027 taught you; it becomes next year's material. Start with the plan on the last page.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Write down what 2027 taught you. That's 2028's raw material.

metal.heading: Sneak preview: 2028, the Earth Monkey
metal.text:
The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins: the Earth Monkey.

Bom: If you're a Metal Day Master, 戊 Earth is resource, support and learning, and the Monkey's 庚 Metal is your own element.

Yeon: After a year that pressed and tested you, 2028 tends to feel like getting your footing back.

More backing, more confidence, more of your kind of people around. Close 2027 by thanking whoever got you through the heat; those links carry forward. One last page: your plan.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: After the heat, 2028 gives you footing. Thank your helpers now.

water.heading: Sneak preview: 2028, the Earth Monkey
water.text:
The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins: the Earth Monkey.

Bom: If you're a Water Day Master, 戊 Earth is power, structure and responsibility, and the Monkey's 庚 Metal is resource, the source that refills water.

Yeon: Bigger expectations and real support, arriving together. Like a promotion that comes with an assistant.

In December, decide which commitments you'd be proud to hold, and say no early to the rest. The last page puts it all on one sheet.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: 2028: more expected of you, more help too. Pick your commitments.

mood.text:
The saju year starts here, at Ipchun, not on January 1st. 壬寅: a big river feeding a young tree.

Bom: Plans suddenly feel possible. Write down what you want from 2027 while your head is this clear.

Yeon: Don't book every weekend until June. Eleven more months are coming and the best ones aren't always first.

癸卯, rain on the Rabbit, is spring's softest month. Things grow underground before anything shows.

Bom: Gentle starts. Small habits. Messaging the friend you drifted from.

Yeon: Push less, tend more. What you plant quietly now tends to outlast what you force. And April is not quiet. At all.

甲辰, a tall tree in damp earth. Ambition gets a structure, and projects start to look real.

Bom: Commit to what you sketched in February. Sign up, set the date, tell people.

Yeon: The Dragon stores Water underneath, so feelings run deeper than they look. Including yours.

乙巳, a flowering vine in early heat. Invitations multiply and the days feel long and bright.

Bom: Enjoy it. People reach out, ideas travel, everyone's suddenly free for drinks.

Yeon: Count your yeses. The Snake notices who follows through and who just says "omg yes let's". Before the real heat lands, there's something you should know about your elements.

丙午, Sun over Horse: fire stacked on fire in a fire year. The hottest month you'll get.

Bom: Big visible moves. Celebrations, travel, bold conversations.

Yeon: Also peak burnout and peak short tempers. Cool evenings, water and early nights will do more than any productivity app.

丁未 repeats the year's own pillar: candle fire over Goat earth. Whatever 2027 is about for you, it's loudest right now.

Bom: Mid-year check. What's working? What isn't? What would you quietly like to stop?

Yeon: Decide what comes with you into the second half. Not everything gets a ticket.

戊申, mountain over Monkey. The first breath of Metal after a long hot stretch, and heat starts turning into results.

Bom: Organise, finish, decide, file. Deeply satisfying.

Yeon: The Monkey is clever and restless, so expect one brilliant shortcut and four shiny distractions.

己酉, garden earth over Rooster. Harvest, in full.

Bom: Edit your work. Fix the details. Notice what quietly went well this year.

Yeon: The Rooster likes things tidy, so a messy room will hit your mood harder than usual. Then comes the part of the reading about how you're built, and why some months cost you more.

庚戌, sword over Dog. Crisp, decisive, a little ruthless.

Bom: Cut what isn't working. A habit, a commitment, a project that's run its course.

Yeon: Endings now make room. The Dog keeps loyalty strong for whatever you choose to keep. Say no clearly. And kindly. Both.

辛亥, jewel over Pig. Water comes back after months of fire and earth, and everything cools down.

Bom: Rest, quiet beauty, generous company. Small luxuries with zero guilt.

Yeon: Slow down now. December has a question for you and you'll want a clear head.

壬子, Water over Rat. Deep winter. The year's fire is fully out and the mood turns inward.

Bom: Inner work. Honest planning. Your closest people.

Yeon: Big public pushes feel twice as heavy right now. Quiet preparation feels natural. Go with it.

癸丑, rain over Ox, closes the Fire Goat year in January 2028. A field waiting under frost.

Bom: Tie up loose ends. Rest properly.

Yeon: No dramatic finale required. The next Ipchun is only weeks away, and it's already peeking at you.

god_a.text:
Your twin runs this month's stem: same element, same polarity. Its saju name: Friend, 比肩.

Bom: You trust your own way of doing things, and you're drawn to people who think like you. Great for solo projects and straight talk between equals.

Yeon: Two people with identical instincts can also dig in over who loads the dishwasher wrong. Let someone win one.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Twin month: your own instincts, doubled. Work solo, talk straight.

god_a.text:
Enter the rival: your element in the opposite polarity, running the month. Its saju name: Rob Wealth, 劫財, which sounds like a heist film.

Yeon: Lively people, competition, collaboration, all at once.

Bom: Teams can do a lot right now. Rivalries can waste just as much. Choose the team.

Yeon: Keep shared plans clear about who does what. Impulsive promises made at 11pm count as promises.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rival month: competitors or teammates. Pick teammates.

god_a.text:
On top of the month sits the feast, the gentlest kind of output. Its saju name: Eating God, 食神, and yes, it involves food.

Bom: Host, cook, learn something artsy, share a skill. Enjoy life without writing a justification for it.

Yeon: Ideas come easily. Let yourself play. The productivity can wait a few days. It won't go anywhere. Sadly.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Feast month: make things, eat well, play a little.

god_a.text:
Watch your mouth: the loudmouth is in charge, the bold edge of expression. Its saju name: Hurting Officer, 傷官.

Yeon: Brilliant ideas. Brutal feedback. Rules feel optional. Diplomacy goes on holiday.

Bom: Great for pitching, writing, performing or redesigning the thing that annoys you.

Yeon: Risky for the strongly worded message. Draft it. Sleep. Reread. Then decide. Usually: don't.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Loudmouth month: brilliant and blunt. Draft, sleep, then send. Or don't.

god_a.text:
The open door is on top this month: chances that come through people. Its saju name: Indirect Wealth, 偏財.

Bom: Say yes to the coffee, the event, the introduction. Try something new.

Yeon: Not every door leads anywhere. Pick the ones you're genuinely curious about, then actually follow up. "We should totally hang" is not following up.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Open-door month: chances come through people. Walk through one.

god_a.text:
This month runs on the steady harvest, patient effort that adds up. Its saju name: Direct Wealth, 正財.

Bom: Organise your life, finish projects, look after what you already have.

Yeon: Less exciting than an adventure month. More satisfying by the last day of it. Like flossing, but for your life.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Steady-harvest month: patient effort, solid results.

god_a.text:
Boss fight. The month's stem carries the strongest challenge in saju. It's called Seven Killings, 七殺. No, it's not literal.

Yeon: Demanding people. High stakes. Tests of nerve.

Bom: It can show you how much courage you actually have. It can also flatten you if you fight every battle.

Yeon: Pick the one that matters. Protect your sleep. The rest can wait until next month.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Boss-fight month: pressure. Choose your one battle.

god_a.text:
The title sits on top of this month: structure, recognition, being taken seriously. Its saju name: Direct Officer, 正官.

Bom: A good month to accept a role, make a formal promise, show people they can count on you.

Yeon: Rules feel heavier than usual. Keep the useful ones. Quietly ignore the one about the office fridge.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Title month: commit, and be the one people can count on.

god_a.text:
The oddball teacher takes over the stem: intuition, odd ideas, learning alone. Its saju name: Indirect Resource, 偏印.

Bom: Research, journaling, following a strange curiosity wherever it goes.

Yeon: You'll want more time alone. Take it. Just text the people who'd worry if you vanished into a documentary hole for a week.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Oddball-teacher month: follow the curiosity. Text your friends.

god_a.text:
Here comes the safety net: mentors, comfort, people who back you. Its saju name: Direct Resource, 正印.

Bom: Ask for help. Sign up for the course. Accept the lift, the meal, the advice.

Yeon: People are more willing to back you than you think. Let them, then rest like it's your actual job.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Safety-net month: ask for help. It's there.

god_b.text:
The year closes with your twin back in the stem, your own element looking right at you.

Bom: Spend these weeks with people who feel like your own kind.

Yeon: And be honest about 2027. Where did doing it your way help? Where did it keep help out?

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end twin: your people, and an honest look back.

god_b.text:
The rival returns for the final weeks. Peers and shared plans.

Yeon: Settle open agreements before the new year. Return what you borrowed. Yes, that book.

Bom: Then celebrate with whoever got you through the hot months.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end rival: settle shared plans, return the book.

god_b.text:
Winter brings the feast back. Comfort, making things, pleasure.

Bom: End the year with something you make purely for joy, and a long meal with people you love.

Yeon: Permission granted to do nothing useful for one entire afternoon. I've signed it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end feast: a long meal, something made for joy.

god_b.text:
The loudmouth comes back as the year closes. Sharp insight, sharp tongue.

Yeon: Point it at yourself for once. A private, honest review of 2027.

Bom: Turn criticism into resolutions, not complaints. Write down one thing you'll do differently after Ipchun.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end loudmouth: an honest review. Private, and kind.

god_b.text:
The open door reappears near the end of the year. New faces, new ideas.

Bom: Note who shows up now. Some of them will matter in 2028.

Yeon: No need to act yet. Just save the number and say hi in February.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end open door: notice who walks in.

god_b.text:
The steady harvest returns as things wind down. Practical order.

Yeon: Files, home, promises. Tidy all three.

Bom: One boring weekend of sorting now buys you a lighter spring.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end harvest: tidy everything before Ipchun.

god_b.text:
The boss fight shows up at the finish line.

Yeon: Don't take on anything new these weeks. I'm serious.

Bom: Finish what's open, rest, and let the year end without a final heroic push nobody asked for.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end boss fight: finish things. Start nothing.

god_b.text:
The title returns for the closing weeks. Responsibility, wrapped up properly.

Bom: Hand things over cleanly. Close what you promised.

Yeon: And give yourself credit for everything you carried this year. Out loud. To someone.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end title: wrap up, and take the credit.

god_b.text:
The oddball teacher is back as the year closes. Reflection deepens.

Bom: Read, walk, write. Let your gut sketch next year before your spreadsheet gets involved.

Yeon: Your spreadsheet will be furious. Let it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end oddball teacher: let your gut draft 2028.

god_b.text:
The safety net returns for the last weeks of the year.

Bom: Accept help. Sleep deeply. Let people look after you before the next cycle starts at Ipchun.

Yeon: Being looked after is a skill. You're allowed to practise it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end safety net: rest, and let people care for you.

clash.text:
Yeon: This month's animal also clashes with your day branch, the animal under your Day Master.

Expect movement close to home: plans change, routines get shaken, someone near you needs attention.

Bom: Stay flexible, keep the essentials steady, and don't make permanent decisions in a hurry.

combo.text: Bom: The month's animal also pairs up with your day branch. Personal life tends to feel easier: people cooperate, home is calm, conversations land.
Bom: Your day branch finds a partner in this month's animal too, so home and relationships feel backed. Good timing for shared plans and invitations.
Bom: Once more this year, the month's animal harmonises with your day branch. Use the ease for something you'd normally find hard to ask for.

best: Bom: On paper, this is one of your two smoothest months. Its elements bring what your chart needs most. A good window for the important moves.
Bom: Your other smooth month of the year. If you shelved something earlier, this is a decent moment to bring it back.
hard: Yeon: One of the two months where the elements push against your chart's balance. Plan lighter, rest more, and don't judge the whole year by it.
Yeon: Here's your second heavier month. Keep commitments modest and lean on the habits that steady you. It passes. They always do.

love.speaker: bom
love.text: Love and people for 2027. Good. This year has a lot to say about who you let close.

work.speaker: yeon
work.text: Work and building something. So you've already got a vision board. With a Gantt chart behind it.

self.speaker: bom
self.text: Yourself: habits, calm, growth. The quiet goal. Usually the one that changes everything else.

fresh.speaker: yeon
fresh.text: A fresh start. Bold. Let's make sure it's a fresh start and not the same start in a new outfit.

unsaid.speaker: yeon
unsaid.text: You didn't pick a focus for 2027. Classic. The year will pick for you if you don't.

great.speaker: bom
great.text: 2026 felt great. Love that. 2027 is about keeping the good and not getting comfortable.

heavy.speaker: bom
heavy.text: 2026 was heavy. You got through it. That counts for more than you think.

messy.speaker: yeon
messy.text: Messy 2026. Like a group chat with no admin and nine side plots.

quiet.speaker: yeon
quiet.text: 2026 was quiet. Not much happened. You've been on airplane mode. 2027 turns the signal back on.

unsaid.speaker: bom
unsaid.text: No word on 2026. That's okay. Some years don't fit in one word.

strength_titles.strong: Your blind spot: you push too hard
strength_titles.weak: Your blind spot: you give too much

jeong-fire.the-year:
Fire meeting fire, same flavour. Your circle grows and feels like home.

Bom: The Goat underneath brings the Eating God: making things you love, just because.

Yeon: Which means you might finally finish the creative thing. The one with nine drafts.

Bom: Let the year be warm. You're allowed a year that's mostly good.
jeong-fire.the-plan:
There's something you've been keeping private for years. This is the year it gets an audience. Even a tiny one.

Bom: A piece of writing, a skill, a feeling.

Yeon: Find one peer walking a similar road and trade notes regularly. Two candles, twice the light.

Bom: And protect your quiet hours, because even a confident year needs rest. Self-trust plus a little company is the formula.

jeong-fire.speaker: bom
jeong-fire.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the candle, the year shares your flame.

jeong-fire.speaker: yeon
jeong-fire.text: Shares your flame. So suddenly you have friends. You'll need to reply to messages. Brave.

jeong-fire.speaker: bom
jeong-fire.text: A warm year. People, creativity, and making things for the love of it.

jeong-fire.speaker: yeon
jeong-fire.text: Your circle grows in February. Yes, that means replying to messages.

jeong-fire.speaker: bom
jeong-fire.text: The thing you've been hiding gets shared this spring. Even with three people.

jeong-fire.speaker: yeon
jeong-fire.text: Confident summer. Still needs sleep. Guard the quiet hours.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

jeong-fire.strong:
A strong Candle in a fire year can feel unstoppable. Unstoppable also describes stubbornness.

Bom: Strong chart, so intense months and big changes don't knock you off balance.

Yeon: The blind spot is pushing through the months that ask for a pause. Make those maintenance months: fewer launches, more care.

Bom: Watch the stubborn streak. Being right and being kind can happen in the same sentence.
jeong-fire.weak:
A softer Candle gets real backup this year. More warmth around you than usual.

Bom: Your chart is the lighter kind, so pacing matters. Supportive months feel easier, demanding ones heavier.

Yeon: Front-load the important stuff into the smooth months. Coast through the rest without guilt.

Bom: Use the extra warmth to step forward once. Just one step further into the room.

jeong-fire.title: 2027: you get a crowd. You'll have to reply to the group chat.
jeong-fire.text:
The year's fire is the same as yours, candle to candle. Saju calls it the Friend. More people who get you. More warmth around you than you're used to.

Bom: You'll feel less alone this year.

Yeon: You'll feel less alone and slightly overwhelmed by brunch invitations.
jeong-fire.end: Yeon: More warmth sounds lovely. It comes with one thing you'll have to learn. Next page.

cliff.jeong-fire: Yeon: February, Candle. The year wakes up warm, and the first | person you let closer is not the one you'd have bet on.

jeong-fire.speaker: yeon
jeong-fire.text: Your plan for 2027: finish one creative thing. Imperfect. Released. Done.
